meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

howto.what: 当你要求做发布前审查时,Claude 会先汇总自上次 npm 发布以来的所有代码改动,再分派最多 10 个后台智能体逐组分析,并会同 5 个智能体做整体复查,最后由 1 个智能体综合判断,给出是否可发布、版本号建议和破坏性变更清单。
howto.when: 当用户明确说出“pre-publish review”“review before publish”“release review”等触发词,要求做发布前审查时触发;普通的发布请求不会触发。

say.note: 启动完整的发布前检查流程

say.text: 这版代码能安全发布到 npm 吗？
发布前看看有没有破坏性变更
say.note: 会汇总改动并分析风险

howto.what_en: On request, Claude detects unpublished changes since last npm release, groups them, spawns up to 10 agents for per-group analysis, runs a 5-agent holistic review, then an oracle gives release readiness, version bump, and breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Only triggers when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review'); a plain publish or release request must not trigger it.
